info.title: CF Meet Privacy Relay internal API
info.description: Internal HTTP surface of services/privacy-relay: GET /health (public) and the service-authenticated /internal/v1 API used by the authenticated platform ingress (Calling) and by Calling's protected-call authorization. Every /internal/v1 path — including unknown ones — requires a valid service token; customer credentials are refused. Scope comes only from the signed delegated platform context; bodies refuse unknown members (tenantId, applicationId, environmentId, status, version, authorization results). Commands carry {idempotencyKey, request}.

get.description: Liveness and database reachability. Public; reveals no configuration.

post.description: Create a communication context. Requires an internal service token (X-CF-Service-Authorization), the receiver-granted permission communication-context.write and a signed delegated platform context (the only scope).

Decide (and record) whether source may communicate with every target, on channel, over route, under the relay session NOW: evaluates the current context AND the current session (their intersection) at server time. Every decision is recorded. Used by Calling before every protected call creation and transfer introduction; Calling fails closed without an answer. Requires an internal service token (X-CF-Service-Authorization), the receiver-granted permission communication.authorize and a signed delegated platform context (the only scope).
Calling only: issue a short-lived Contact Resolution Grant for one authorized public-network call leg. Reveals no contact value. Every attempt is audited.

Telephony only: exchange a valid, unexpired, unconsumed grant (same scope, contact, call, leg; unchanged authority; enabled and effectively VERIFIED contact) for the canonical E.164 value of that one execution. The response is never logged or persisted; every attempt is audited without the number.
Lend a temporary relay number to the session (deterministic, SKIP LOCKED selection; idempotent per session). 201 new, 200 the existing assignment (Idempotent-Replayed: true).

200.description: The existing assignment of this session.

get.description: The session's assignment in any status (RELAY_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_FOUND when it never had one).

post.description: Restrictive (never gated by a kill switch) and idempotent: routing authority ends now, the number enters cooldown.

cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer <service token> (contract cfmeet.platform.internal-http). Permissions come only from Privacy Relay's trust bundle.
